verification_policy: Direct research with cross-source acquisition verification. Preserve source conflicts and do not infer Ultimate Finish requirements without explicit evidence.
research_scope: Darkness Twin Star — Ki Blast Super.

verification_audit.classification_finding: Current Xenoverse 2 references identify Darkness Twin Star as a Ki Blast Super using two orbiting energy spheres that can act defensively or be launched offensively.
verification_audit.acquisition_finding: Lord Slug training is the documented acquisition route; current mentor documentation places Darkness Twin Star as Lesson 2, and independent reference material confirms it is learned from Slug's Lesson 2.
verification_audit.ultimate_finish_policy: No Ultimate Finish requirement is asserted. The evidence establishes instructor training rather than a PQ reward condition, so the field remains null.
verification_audit.damage_policy: Exact damage values are not promoted as canonical because version stability is not established.

records.name: Darkness Twin Star
records.character_source: Lord Slug and customizable partner skillsets documented by current references
records.skill_description: A Ki Blast Super that creates two energy spheres which orbit the user, damaging nearby enemies and blocking standard Ki blasts; a second input launches the spheres at the opponent.
records.mechanics_notes: Current reference material describes an initial defensive state in which the two spheres orbit the user and can block standard Ki blasts. Pressing the input again fires the spheres offensively. Explosions can knock nearby opponents upward. The Xenoverse 2 tutorial has also been documented under the alternate wording 'Dark Twin Star', while the skill's canonical name is Darkness Twin Star.
